items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: He was calling him Sidley, Sidley, and he was talking to him like you talk to a little kid... Bunk accused Sidney of going out with Bunk's girl

ctx.x: Yeah, that was considerably later than their Boston fiasco.

Yeah. He was calling him Sidley, Sidley, and he was talking to him like you talk to a little kid, you know. And Sidney, whose dignity was not accustomed to such a position, was kind of embarrassed. But after a while he just realized he had to take it, so he stood up pretty well. And Bunk accused Sidney of going out with Bunk's girl here in New Orleans back maybe 50 years before, you know. And Bunk says, I know about you. I know that you used to date this girl, you know. And Sidney says, well tell me Bunk. He…
It really had been Bunk's girl then I guess. Yeah, yeah. Sidney didn't deny it either. No, he agreed.
